photo.title: Group of 7 women and children beside a hut; at the edge of a lake; one lady carrying a container on her head.
Group portrait of five boys, sitting on a raft, at the edge of Lake Turkana (formerly called Lake Rudolf).
El Molo girl wearing beaded "fertility necklace", headband and earrings; face painted in red.

textile.title: Length of rope used for tying rafts and nets.
Hank of twisted rope made locally from Doum-palm leaf fibre. One end unravelling slightly.
Hank of twisted rope made from palm leaf fibre. One end unravelling slightly.
Hank of twisted rope made locally from Doum-palm leaf fibre. Appears to taper towards one end.

ceramic.title: Small globular pot with rounded base and simple rim. Decorated around the rim with several rows of impressions; remains of two lug handles just below the rim. Both handles broken and missing.

garment.title: Skirt made from fishing nets and worn by women. Rectangular panel of fish nets; waistband made from a length of cord at the top, with a loop at one end.

Skirt made from fishing nets and worn by women. Length of twisted plant fibre cord sewn into a roughly rectangular panel; waistband made from a length of cord at the top, with a loop at one end; fibre fringe at the bottom.

household.title: Fishing hook and line used by women when fishing from rocks. Simple iron hook without barb, attached by the shaft to a long length of plant fibre cord.

Hippopotamus harpoon head with rope. Angular iron blade with single bard, flat on one side and with mid-rib on the other; iron shaft with circular cross-section; length of thick, plant fibre rope tied to the shaft using a length of plant fibre cord.

other.title: Unfinished fishing net. Length of fishing net made from plant fibre cord; loop of cord at one end.
